executive_summary:
The host plays an analysis by the YouTuber Nicci (A-2537.1) arguing that the back-camera footage Terryl Farnsworth showed the host over FaceTime was likely zoomed in or cropped. Nicci's clip compares it with wide-angle back-camera shots from other 2025 American Comeback Tour stops. The host adds the opening of her FaceTime call with Terryl (A-2538.1), in which she says he opens a drive she suspects is the camera's SD card on his desktop in Scottsdale. She says that in their September 17 and 19 conversations Terryl never told her he lacked the footage or had given the SD card to federal agents. She also notes that Charlie Kirk was seated on a new platform and that, by her review, the camera directly behind his head first appeared in 2025 (A-2539).

According to an unverified tip the host relays (A-2540.1), in late 2016 Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta met the holders of a pending patent for an interchangeable-caliber gun. The tip says the four had dinner in Scottsdale, where Lori and Larry offered access to government contracts and Erika Frantzve arrived unannounced. The host says Erika was then dating Cabot Phillips, not Charlie Kirk, and that nothing came of the deal. She links this to Victor Marx's interest in the Fold AR patent and to her view that Jeffrey Epstein began his career in weapons trafficking.

The host rebuts a Blake Neff X post calling her dishonest about whether Tyler Robinson's parents recognized the rifle (A-2541.1). She cites a Daily Mail headline (A-2541.2) and a Robinson text message from the charging document (A-2541.3). She again asks TPUSA to answer donors' claims that Charlie never named Erika his successor at Aspen. She then reads Laura Loomer's "God hates you" tweet (A-2542.1) and quotes a 2019 Spectator profile in which Loomer described cocaine use, a suicide attempt and social-media addiction (A-2542.2).

In the comments segment the host discusses the continuance fight in the Robinson case and asks for tips on whether Charlie Kirk's body was cremated (A-2543.1). She also notes newly added lines in Robinson's messages, comments on Kash Patel's suit against The Atlantic, and announces an interview with Corby Hall after Victor Marx declined to join him.

nodes.name: Lori Frantzve 2016 Gun Patent Dinner
nodes.description: Investigation target: a tip that in late fall 2016 Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta met two holders of a pending patent for an interchangeable-caliber gun. The tip says they met at a Salt Lake City expo where Lori was promoting G-Tech Industries' EMP technology. They then held a dinner in Scottsdale, offered an introduction to their G-Tech angel investor and claimed access to government contracts. According to the tip, Erika Frantzve arrived unannounced, and her mother mentioned that Erika was dating a man with big political connections. The host says nothing came of the deal, the patent is now approved, and the patent holder later had a lawsuit with Victor Marx.

claims.label: Nicci Shows Back-Camera Shots From Other 2025 Tour Stops
claims.claim: In a video by the YouTuber Nicci that the host plays, back-camera shots from American Comeback Tour stops are shown, including Florida State University on February 28, 2025 and the University of Southern California on March 3, 2025, as well as San Francisco, San Diego, Long Beach, Boise and Washington State.

claims.transcript_snippet: On February 28th, 2025, the American Comeback Tour did a stop at Florida State University and here is the back camera shot.

claims.label: UVU footage either zoomed that day or cropped afterwards
claims.claim: Nicci's video says the back camera was always used as a wide-angle camera, yet the ground cannot be seen in the UVU footage Terryl shared. It concludes that either the camera was zoomed in that day or Terryl zoomed in afterwards and showed a cropped version.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the camera's recorded settings and the native file from September 10, 2025 to determine whether the zoom was optical at capture or applied in editing.
claims.transcript_snippet: The camera is a wide-angle camera and was always used as such. However, in the footage that Terryl has selectively shared with Candace, you cannot see the ground.

claims.label: Host phoned Terryl on September 17 after the takedown video went viral

claims.investigative_direction: Produce the host's call logs with Terryl Farnsworth for September 17–19, 2025.

claims.label: Terryl agreed on September 19 to show the footage after citing Erika
claims.claim: The host says Terryl was hesitant on September 17, saying he wanted to protect the footage and Erika Kirk, and that on September 19 he agreed to get on a call and show her the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Terryl's messages with the host and with Erika Kirk between September 17 and 19, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then on the 19th, he sort of broke and said, "Okay, no, let's just get on the call. I'm happy to show you the footage."

claims.label: The "YOLO" drive on Terryl's desktop is likely the camera's SD card
claims.claim: Showing the opening of her FaceTime call, the host says she suspects the "YOLO" drive on Terryl's desktop is what he named the SD card, which she says he should not have had. She notes that Sony cameras automatically label a "clip" folder.
claims.investigative_direction: Have a forensic examiner review the FaceTime recording, and obtain the SD card's volume label and chain-of-custody records.
claims.transcript_snippet: It is my suspicion that that YOLO drive that you're seeing on the left-hand side is likely what he named his SD card.

claims.label: Terryl never said he lacked the footage or had given the SD card to the feds
claims.claim: The host says that in their September 17 and 19 conversations Terryl never told her he did not have the footage or the SD card, or that he had given the SD card to federal agents.

claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk told Megyn Kelly that TPUSA has the Aspen video, yet it declined to share it. She says Blake Neff instead accused her of being a psychopath, as with a knife on a subway, as the reason it could not be shared.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive Neff's statement and Erika Kirk's Megyn Kelly interview remark on the video.
claims.transcript_snippet: And you accused me of being a psychopath with with a with a gun or a knife rather on a subway and that's why you couldn't share it.

claims.label: TPUSA put up a recreation of the tent Charlie died under for selfies
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA put up a recreation of the tent Charlie Kirk died under for selfies.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect AmFest photos and TPUSA event plans showing the tent recreation.
claims.transcript_snippet: you you put up a tent uh a recreation of a tent that Charlie had died under for selfies.

claims.label: Laura Loomer tweeted "God hates you" at the host
claims.claim: The host reads Laura Loomer's tweet to her saying God gave Charlie to Erika because God hates the host, and says it drew about 6,000 replies.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the post with its timestamp and reply count.
claims.transcript_snippet: God hates you at Real Candace O. It's why he gave Charlie to Erika and why you didn't even get to say goodbye to him.

claims.label: Loomer says she speaks to Trump several times a day
claims.claim: The host says that, according to Laura Loomer, she speaks to Donald Trump by phone multiple times a day, and that one of his first calls after attacking Iran was to her.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Loomer's public statements on call frequency and the reported post-strike call.
claims.transcript_snippet: According to her, multiple times a day she speaks to him on the phone. One of the first phone calls he made after attacking Iran was to Laura Loomer.

claims.label: 2019 Spectator profile: Loomer described cocaine use and a suicide attempt
claims.claim: The host quotes a 2019 Spectator article, "The Tale of Laura Loomer," in which Loomer said she dealt with depression by using cocaine; the host adds that Loomer was 23. Loomer also said she once drove to a cliff in February and tried to kill herself.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the 2019 Spectator article and confirm the quotes.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had really bad anxiety and depression and then I started to basically deal with depression by doing cocaine.

claims.label: People in Melania's circle say Loomer is the person most likely to harm Trump
claims.claim: The host says that, as she understands it, people in Melania Trump's circle have said Laura Loomer would be the person most likely to harm Donald Trump.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any on-record source from Melania Trump's staff or associates.
claims.transcript_snippet: as I understand it, Melania is in her circle, have said this, that she would be the most likely person to harm Donald Trump.

claims.label: Laura Loomer is not allowed to own guns
claims.claim: The host says Laura Loomer is not allowed to own guns, and later that there are 50 states in which she cannot own one.
claims.investigative_direction: Check NICS-disqualifying records such as involuntary commitment orders in Florida.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, you can understand why she's not allowed to own guns.

claims.label: Loomer said she wants the host's children to suffer and live on the streets
claims.claim: The host says Laura Loomer said the day before that she wants the host's children to suffer and live on the streets, and that Loomer is also attacking the host's lawyer and in-laws.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive Loomer's posts referencing the host's children, lawyer and in-laws.
claims.transcript_snippet: She wants my children to suffer and to live on the streets because she doesn't like that I'm against what Israel is doing.

claims.label: Loomer told the Spectator she became addicted to social media
claims.claim: The host quotes the Spectator article in which Loomer said, after losing Twitter access, that she became addicted to social media, substituted her lows with adrenaline rushes on Twitter, and had withdrawals when banned.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the 2019 Spectator article and confirm the quote.
claims.transcript_snippet: I became addicted to social media. I kind of lived off of the adrenaline.

claims.label: Clip of Loomer on Alex Jones saying her life was ruined
claims.claim: The host plays a clip of Laura Loomer on Alex Jones's show shouting that her life is ruined and that she does not want people calling her a conspiracy theorist.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Infowars episode and air date of the clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't want TO LISTEN TO PEOPLE TELL ME THAT I'M A CONSPIRACY THEORIST.

claims.label: Trump called Tucker Carlson, Megyn Kelly and the host mentally ill while taking Loomer's advice on Iran
claims.claim: The host says the question to ask is whether Donald Trump is mentally fit if he makes a conscious decision to tweet out that Tucker Carlson, Megyn Kelly and Candace Owens are mentally ill while inviting Laura Loomer into his inner circle for advice on Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the Truth Social post and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: If he makes a conscious decision to tweet out that Tucker Carlson and Megyn Kelly and Candace Owens are mentally ill while he invites into his inner circle advice about what he should do to Iran, a person like Laura Loomer.

claims.label: The Robinson judge was appointed by Governor Cox
claims.claim: The host says many people looked into the judge in Tyler Robinson's case and found it suspicious that he was appointed by Governor Cox and lacked experience for a case of this size.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Utah judicial appointment record for the presiding judge.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know a lot of people um had looked into the judge and thought that it was very suspicious that he was appointed by Governor Cox

claims.label: 600,000 files were dumped on the defense in March
claims.claim: The host says prosecutors dumped 600,000 files on Tyler Robinson's defense in March, about seven months into the case, making a continuance reasonable.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the court's discovery orders and the defense's continuance motion.
claims.transcript_snippet: We looked they dumped 600,000 files on them in March.

claims.label: Judge earlier assured the defense a trial date could be moved
claims.claim: The host says the defense asked not to set a date until discovery was in hand, and the judge replied that the date could always be bumped. She says a refusal now, after Erika Kirk asserted her victim's rights, would be telling.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the hearing transcript in which the date was set.
claims.transcript_snippet: Remember, the the the defense said, "Let's not put a day on the calendar until we have our discovery stuff and we we'll have a better idea."

claims.label: Erika's "one thing for my kids" reply to Fox News on the burial location
claims.claim: The host says that when Fox News asked Erika Kirk where Charlie Kirk was buried, she asked to keep one thing for her kids. The host disputes that reasoning.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the Fox News interview segment with its air date.
claims.transcript_snippet: And they asked about where he was buried, and it was like, "One thing for your kids, girl, you took us into the casket.

claims.label: Erika moved Charlie's body a couple of times
claims.claim: The host says she learned early on that Erika Kirk had moved Charlie Kirk's body a couple of times.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Utah and Arizona burial-transit permits and funeral-home records.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I I had wondered because I learned early on that she had moved the body a couple of times.

claims.label: Charlie's body first went to a burial and cremation service
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's body was first taken to a burial plus cremation services provider and then somewhere else, and asks whether he was cremated after a Catholic funeral mass.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the first funeral provider and check cremation authorization records.
claims.transcript_snippet: at first his body was taken to a place that was a a burial plus cremation services, and then it was taken somewhere else

claims.label: Host asks for tips on whether Charlie Kirk was cremated and pledges source protection
claims.claim: The host asks for tips at candaceowens.com on whether Charlie Kirk was cremated, says she will fully protect sources' identities, and says none of her sources has ever been outed.
claims.investigative_direction: Track tips received on the cremation question and corroborate with funeral records.
claims.transcript_snippet: More tips at candaceowens. com. More tips at candaceowens. com. We will protect your identity entirely.

claims.label: Viewer says they have footage that could change the investigation
claims.claim: The host reads a viewer comment from "Keeping faith with Father Joseph" saying they have footage that could change the investigation, and asks them to email it to the show.
claims.investigative_direction: Follow up on whether the footage was submitted and authenticate it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Keeping faith with Father Joseph writes, Candace, I have footage that could change the investigation. DM me. Email it to us.

claims.label: New sentences, including the "pooch" line, were added to Robinson's messages
claims.claim: The host says that in the affidavits, ellipses in Tyler Robinson's previously released messages have been filled with added sentences. One, sent to Lance Twiggs, reads "I hope that pooch has a bad sniffer."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the message text in the original charging document with the later affidavits line by line.
claims.transcript_snippet: they had some ellipses at various points in the messages that we got, and they've added sentences.

claims.label: Kash Patel is suing The Atlantic over a report that he is a drunk
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel is suing, she thinks The Atlantic ("is it The Atlantic"), because it reported that he is a drunk.
claims.investigative_direction: Check federal and state dockets for a Patel v. The Atlantic defamation complaint.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I feel like Kash Patel right now suing um is it The Atlantic because they said that he's a drunk.

claims.label: Victor Marx declined to join Corby Hall; Hall interview to air next day
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx did not want to join Corby Hall on the show, so she kept her appointment with Hall for an interview airing the next day. She says Marx had demanded to bring his wife and set terms of engagement.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's correspondence with Victor Marx on interview terms.
claims.transcript_snippet: Obviously, you know, Victor Marx uh did not want to join with Corby Hall. So we kept our appointment with Corby Hall.
